why the emulator lacks the link.cause: Chromium on Windows reports STATE_SYSTEM_LINKED for every node whose role is a link; the emulator reports it only when the AX state `linked` is set, so an anchor with no href is not "in a link" (gecko_ia2 fillVBuf: in_link, interactive), is not interactive, and an empty node of no text leaves no line in the buffer
